remarks: You'll Love living in the center of it all on Washington Street in the Heart of Historic SONO! Chic, Sun-filled 1 bedroom corner unit with high ceilings, extra large living room with dining area with exposed brick and parquet flooring overlooking the Ironworks Courtyard. Newly renovated bathroom and super convenient washer/dryer in the unit! Enjoy lots of storage, dishwasher and granite countertops in the light filled kitchen. Everything SONO has to offer is at your doorstep! Restaurants, bars, movie theater, supermarkets, Metro North, Norwalk Harbor, The Oyster Festival, SONO Arts Festival, The Maritime Aquarium and the New SONO Mall.
